## 测试反馈 / Feedback

**1. Skill 是否正确理解了你的工作？**
Did the Skill understand your work correctly?

**2. 文件筛选结果是否合理？有没有遗漏重要项目？**
Were the selected files relevant? Were any important projects missed?

**3. Career Evidence Package 是否符合你的真实经历？**
Did the Career Evidence Package reflect your actual experience?

**4. 有没有发现过去被你忽略或低估的能力？**
Did the Skill uncover any strengths or capabilities you had previously overlooked or underestimated?

**5. 能力长板、短板和职业定位是否符合真实情况？**
Did the identified strengths, gaps, and career positioning feel accurate?

**6. 有没有出现错误归因或缺少证据的推断？**
Were there any incorrect attributions or conclusions made without enough evidence?

**7. 最终报告中最有帮助的部分是什么？**
Which part of the final report was most useful?

**8. 哪些地方明显需要改进？**
What clearly needs improvement?
